Then reason: According to the position near the west coast of the continent around the 30° latitude line in the figure, and the bending characteristics of the isotherm of the coldest month affected by the thermal difference between sea and land, it can be judged that this place is located near 30° in the Southern Hemisphere on the west coast of the continent. The coldest month belongs to the local cold season; this latitude is affected by the Southern Hemisphere westerlies, and northwesterly winds prevail near the ground, that is, the wind blows from northwest to southeast. The flag on the ship will flutter downwind with the wind, so the flag flutters toward the southeast.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中左侧为海、右侧为陆，甲港位于大陆西岸，附近标有30°纬线，最冷月等温线在海陆之间弯曲。再根据最冷月海陆热力差异和等温线弯曲判断该地为南半球30°附近的大陆西岸。冷季该纬度受南半球西风带影响，近地面盛行西北风，风从西北吹向东南；旗帜随风飘向下风向，因此答案为东南。
method.CoT_raw:

再推理：根据图中30°纬线附近大陆西岸的位置，以及最冷月等温线受海陆热力差异影响的弯曲特征，可判断该地位于南半球30°附近的大陆西岸。最冷月属于当地冷季，此纬度受南半球西风带影响，近地面盛行西北风，即风从西北吹向东南。船上旗帜会随风飘向下风向，所以旗帜飘向东南。
